name: Begin TOTP Enrollment
summary: Begins authenticator enrollment for the current authenticated durable identity and stages the secret material required to configure an authenticator.

sourceReferences.note: BeginTotpEnrollmentAsync generates and securely stages authenticator secret material and returns the otpauth URI and secret.
Enrollment begins only after an explicit action on auth.mfa.totp.start; the resulting QR code and secret are displayed on auth.mfa.totp.enroll.
